responsibility: Implements a pre-register-allocation RTL SSA optimization pass that propagates non-VLMAX AVL values through RVV instructions. The pass analyzes def-use chains of vector instructions with VL operands, finds safe cases where VLMAX tail-agnostic operations can reuse a downstream explicit AVL without changing semantics, rewrites instruction patterns accordingly, and can also simplify VLMAX to immediate AVL for fixed-ZVL configurations, reducing redundant `vsetvli` pressure before the main vsetvl pass.
